description: This file is a React component for creating a new course in an instructor dashboard. It handles course metadata, modules, chapters, quizzes, assessments, and file uploads, integrating with various APIs for course creation and content generation.

methods.name: getContentIcon
methods.description: Returns an icon component based on the content type.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Adds a new module to the course modules list.

methods.name: addChapter
methods.description: Adds a new chapter/content item to a specified module.

methods.name: updateModuleTitle
methods.description: Updates the title of a specific module.

methods.name: updateChapter
methods.description: Updates properties of a specific chapter/content item.

methods.name: deleteChapter
methods.description: Removes a chapter/content item from a module.

methods.name: toggleChapterPublished
methods.description: Toggles the published state of a chapter.

methods.name: handleContentReorder
methods.description: Reorders chapters/content items within a module.

methods.name: addManualQuestion
methods.description: Adds a manual question to the quiz question list.

methods.name: updateManualQuestion
methods.description: Updates a manual question in the quiz list.

methods.name: removeManualQuestion
methods.description: Removes a manual question from the list.

methods.name: handleGenerateQuiz
methods.description: Calls the API to generate quiz questions based on prompt or file content.

methods.name: handleGenerateAssignment
methods.description: Calls the API to generate assignment description based on prompt or file content.

methods.name: addQuizPlaceholder
methods.description: Adds a new quiz placeholder to the list of quizzes to be created.

methods.name: removeQuizPlaceholder
methods.description: Removes a quiz placeholder by ID.

methods.name: addAssessmentPlaceholder
methods.description: Adds a new assessment placeholder (manual or AI) to the list.

methods.name: removeAssessmentPlaceholder
methods.description: Removes an assessment placeholder by ID.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles final course creation, including API calls for course, quizzes, and assessments, then redirects to course dashboard.
